shortDescription: Lucid Group NASDAQ:LCID and European shared-mobility company Bolt on Thursday said they have agreed to partner on the development and deployment of autonomous mobility services across Europe, with Bolt aiming to deploy at least 25,000 fully autonomous Lucid vehicles across multiple European cities…

children: and European shared-mobility company Bolt on Thursday said they have agreed to partner on the development and deployment of autonomous mobility services across Europe, with Bolt aiming to deploy at least 25,000 fully autonomous Lucid vehicles across multiple European cities and countries.
The companies said the vehicles will be based on Lucid’s
upcoming midsize platform and are expected to use Nvidia’s Hyperion autonomous-vehicle architecture, which combines high-performance computing with a standardized sensor suite.

The partnership will focus on developing a vehicle platform designed for SAE Level 4 autonomous mobility, with Bolt involved from product development through commercial operations. Bolt said it will help define vehicle, software, safety, and rider-experience requirements while building the fleet infrastructure, operating systems, and city partnerships needed for deployment. The company intends to own and operate the fleet.
The initiative forms part of Bolt’s broader ambition to have 100,000 autonomous vehicles on its platform by 2035, the companies said.
will lead the automaker’s side of the program, bringing together its artificial intelligence, advanced driver-assistance, autonomy, and digital functions.

The companies said they will work with autonomous-driving technology partners, European regulators, and policymakers to support the introduction of autonomous mobility services, citing Europe’s vehicle, technology, and regulatory requirements.
Shares were trading about 4.2% higher in the premarket trading on Thursday.

title: Lucid, Bolt partner on Level 4 autonomous mobility platform
